H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)

H7125: an encountering, accidental, friendly or hostile (also adverbially, opposite)

H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing

H1104: to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy
H3847: properly, wrap around, i.e. (by implication) to put on agarment or clothe (oneself, or another), literally or figuratively
H1322: shame (the feeling and the condition, as well as its cause); by implication (specifically) an idol

H1897: to murmur (in pleasure or anger); by implication, to ponder
